description: Measured Criterion mean baselines for the hard-ish C08 perf gate. Values are nanoseconds (Criterion point estimates). Seeded 2026-07-11 from local cargo bench (sample-size 10); CI gate fails above mean_ns * (1 + max_regression). Refresh via scripts/seed-bench-baseline.py after ubuntu-latest cargo bench.

config_toml_from_str.notes: Measured ~20 µs; baseline uses ~2× headroom for CI variance.
